-111.89400,33.64540.name: ACFS Fertility, Arizona Associates for Reproductive Health
-111.89400,33.64540.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Ketan S. Patel, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

127.69612,36.63839.name: CentralBio Co., Ltd.
127.69612,36.63839.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

0.26173,51.13092.name: London Women's Clinic - Tunbridge Wells
0.26173,51.13092.company: Satellite clinic to London Women's Clinic Bromley
0.26173,51.13092.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to London Women's Clinic Bromley. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-77.10200,38.99900.name: NIH RePORTER
-77.10200,38.99900.desc: Every NIH grant, searchable by investigator, institution and amount. It is the most complete public record anywhere of who is paid to do biological research, and the practical starting point for tracing where a technology on this map came from — nearly every platform here traces back to a grant number that can be looked up. Comparable databases exist for almost no other funder, so the American record is disproportionately visible and everyone else's work is harder to see.

54.40000,24.45000.name: Silal / UAE food security investment
54.40000,24.45000.desc: An Abu Dhabi state food company buying and building agricultural capacity at home and abroad. Gulf states import most of what they eat and have responded by acquiring farmland and food technology overseas — so a country with almost no agriculture is now a significant owner of other countries’ agriculture.

-93.62500,41.58680.name: Hy-Line International
-93.62500,41.58680.state: Des Moines, Iowa — an EW Group company
-93.62500,41.58680.desc: A layer breeding company owned by the same German group as the German and American layer brands beside it, distributing breeding stock into more than a hundred countries. The concentration is the entry rather than the company: by one 2022 estimate the group holds around 44 per cent of the international broiler genetics market through its broiler subsidiary while also leading layer genetics through this business and two others. A reader who has followed the seed facet's four majors should note that poultry is more concentrated still, and attracts a fraction of the attention.
